How does SCRIPE Identity & Multi-Tenant SSO V2 deliver 36/36 security remediation, Smart Adaptive SSO, and CLI hardening?

Long image

A

Answer

SCRIPE V2 closes 36 of 36 confirmed security findings and unifies Smart Adaptive SSO across all 6 seeded tenants plus Platform Root. Hardened scripe-cli streaming and 1,926 backend tests plus 21 Playwright screenshots verify the release.1

  1. Security Audit run-2 mitigated 2 Critical, 17 High, 16 Medium, and 1 Low findings across Identity, SSO, RBAC, Delegations, Media, Host Cookies, and Frontend stores.1
  2. SsoProviderButtons adapts across AHLY, CITY, FALCON, APEX, COMMUNITY, ACFC, Platform Root, and fail-closed UNKNOWN_999 with zero clipping in EN and AR RTL.2
  3. SudoService and CookieAuthMiddleware bind scripe_sudo_token to sid/jti and clear refresh, OIDC, and Sudo cookies atomically while Frontend sign-out wipes Zustand singletons.3
  4. scripe-cli streams 1.37 GB (26 Cobertura files) in 2.63s, removes the -v collision, isolates SQLCMDPASSWORD, enforces shell: false, and guards db outbox purge --confirm.4

Applies toSCRIPE V236/36 Audit6-Tenant SSOCLI

How do Adaptive SSO, 36/36 Security Gates, and CLI Tooling fit together?

Diagram structure
  • Adaptive SSO Login fe_login
  • Account & Store Guard fe_acct
  • Auth-First Rate & Cookies edge_pipe
  • OIDC, SAML & Passkeys sso_core
  • RBAC, Scope & Break-Glass rbac_core
  • SVG & Quota Shield media_core
  • Identity & Cache DB id_store
  • Hardened scripe-cli cli_gate
  • fe_login → edge_pipe · Adaptive SSO
  • fe_acct → edge_pipe · Logout & Sudo
  • edge_pipe → sso_core · Session Check
  • edge_pipe → rbac_core · Auth-First
  • edge_pipe → media_core · Upload Gate
  • sso_core → id_store · IgnoreFilters
  • rbac_core → id_store · Live Grants
  • cli_gate → id_store · Outbox Confirm
  1. Adaptive SSO Login ↗

    Renders full-width [Org] heroes above concise 2-column Google and Microsoft slots, and fails closed on UNKNOWN_999.

  2. Account & Store Guard ↗

    Calls real POST /api/v1/auth/admin/logout, resets useSudoStore, clears usePatOneTimeSecretStore, and isolates sibling tabs on impersonation.

  3. Auth-First Rate & Cookies ↗

    Runs UseCookieAuth and UseAuthentication before rate limiting, and clears scr_refresh_token, scr.oidc.session, and scripe_sudo_token together.

  4. OIDC, SAML & Passkeys ↗

    Enforces EnabledForAdmins/EnabledForUsers, tenant health, SSRF checks, unique SamlSpEntityId, and TwoFactorPendingToken.

  5. RBAC, Scope & Break-Glass ↗

    Blocks self-grant ScopeGrant (#23) and TransferProtection (#27) takeovers while intersecting live grantor permissions on delegations.

  6. SVG & Quota Shield ↗

    Strips SMIL and control-char URIs, checks PNG/file magic bytes, counts active staging bytes in quotas, and applies sandbox CSP on .svg.

  7. Hardened scripe-cli ↗

    Streams 1.37 GB Cobertura XML in 2.63s, removes -v flag conflicts, moves SQL passwords to SQLCMDPASSWORD, and uses shell: false.

Every severity band reached 100% mitigation (2 + 17 + 16 + 1 = 36 findings; 0 partial, 0 unfixed, 0 open leads) across 16 coverage ledger units.1

How do session-bound Sudo cookies and Frontend sign-out prevent cross-session bleed?

Diagram structure
  • Next.js 16 SPA spa
  • Zustand & Broadcast stores
  • Cookie & Sudo Gate edge
  • SudoService sudo
  • Distributed Cache cache
  • spa → edge · Mutation + scripe_sudo_token
  • edge → sudo · ValidateCurrentSessionElevation
  • sudo → cache · Verify sid/jti Hash + TokenSha256
  • cache → sudo · Match or SudoSessionMismatch
  • spa → stores · Reset Sudo, PAT & AppStore
  • spa → edge · POST /api/v1/auth/admin/logout
  • edge → cache · Revoke Refresh & Sudo Ticket
  • edge → spa · Clear Refresh, OidcSession & Sudo
  • stores → spa · Broadcast Logout to Sibling Tabs
  1. SudoService ↗

    Validates HMAC signature, AdminId, and sid/jti SessionHash; if an explicit X-Sudo-Token header is present, never falls back to cookie.

  2. Zustand & Broadcast ↗

    Clears useSudoStore, usePatOneTimeSecretStore, useAppStore, scr_tenant_ctx, and scr_tenant_breadcrumbs, then notifies sibling tabs via Set listeners.

  3. Cookie & Sudo Gate ↗

    CookieAuthMiddleware deletes scr_refresh_token, scr.oidc.session, and scripe_sudo_token together on logout and new SPA session setup.

Live QA Observation on Sudo Session Mismatch

SudoService.Validation.cs intentionally rejects stale cross-session Sudo tickets with 403 Identity.SudoSessionMismatch. Ensure every logout path invokes ClearSudoCookie and treat Identity.SudoSessionMismatch as a fresh Sudo elevation prompt in the UI.

How did scripe-cli evolve to stream 1.37 GB coverage files safely?

Diagram structure
  • Find 26 XML Files scan
  • 4 MB Chunk Stream chunk
  • Max-Hits Map dedup
  • Safe Flags & Env flags
  • shell:false Spawn exec_safe
  • Outbox Confirm? purge_gate
  • chunk → dedup · <= 32 MB carry
  • exec_safe → purge_gate · --confirm
  • flags → exec_safe · no -v clash
  • scan → chunk · <= 512 MB
  1. 4 MB Chunk Stream ↗

    Replaces readFileSync (50 MB crash) with openSync/readSync/closeSync + StringDecoder("utf8"), scanning 1.37 GB across 26 files in 2.63s (59.9 MB heap).

  2. Max-Hits Map ↗

    Extracts complete <class>...</class> blocks across chunk boundaries and computes Math.max per (className, lineNumber) without backtracking regexes.

  3. Safe Flags & Env ↗

    Removes the global -v shorthand collision with subcommands and passes SQL Server credentials through SQLCMDPASSWORD instead of CLI argv.

  4. shell:false Spawn ↗

    Replaces shell-interpolated strings with shell: false argument arrays, path-confined undo journals, and strict regex validation on rebrand.

  5. Outbox Confirm? ↗

    Enforces fail-closed scripe db outbox purge --confirm so destructive Tier 4 purges cannot run implicitly.

Real Disk Cobertura Benchmark
26 files (1.37 GB total, 130.3 MB max) parsed in 2,630.64 ms (59.9 MB heap, 2,851 classes)
Coverage Parser Ceilings
512 MB max file size (MAX_COBERTURA_FILE_BYTES) and 32 MB unclosed carry-over guard
